after.content:
renderApp("/settings/hosts/local-host/general")
  expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "faux" })).toBeInTheDocument()
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("faux Base URL"), { target: { value: "https://next.invalid/v1" } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("faux-1 Display name"), { target: { value: "Faux Prime" } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("faux-1 Capabilities"), { target: { value: "text, streaming" } })
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add custom header" }))
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("Header 1 name"), { target: { value: "X-Tenant" } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("Header 1 credential ID"), { target: { value: "tenant-1" } })
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("faux Profile settings"), { target: { value: "{\"timeoutSeconds\":30}" } })
  fireEvent.blur(screen.getByLabelText("faux Profile settings"))
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save profile" }))
  expect(await screen.findByText("Revision 3")).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(saved).toMatchObject({
    expectedRevision: 2,
    baseUrl: "https://next.invalid/v1",
    headerCredentials: { "X-Tenant": { credentialId: "tenant-1", type: "none" } },
    models: [{ modelId: "faux-1", displayName: "Faux Prime", capabilities: ["text", "streaming"] }],
    settings: { timeoutSeconds: 30 },
  })
  expect(JSON.stringify(saved)).not.toContain("secret")
})
